tests.name: edge functions that call auth.getClaims import a supabase-js that has it
tests.reason: The change is two supabase-js import bumps in Supabase edge functions plus this guard; the community-app bundle is unchanged. Edge functions have no staging project (one shared Supabase), so the redeploy of get-proactive-context is verified read-only after the approved manual dispatch (list_edge_functions versions, no 5xx/TypeError in its logs). The guard fails on the old imports and passes on the bump.
